SELECT
    TABLE_SCHEMA,
    TABLE_NAME
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'Sales'
  AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;
